cc:Work.dc:title: Tango Mixer's Project Banner
cc:Work.dc:description:
This file contains icons from tango-icon-theme, nome-icon-theme, and humanity-icon-theme. Please check https://github.com/kuanyui/tango-mixer for the LICENSE of each icon theme.
I'm unable to find out the original font of `tango!` logo, so I use TeX `Gyre Schola` / `TeX Gyre Bonum Math` and modify the path arbitrarily.
